three rounds of DVO training improves Llama3-8B-Instruct's accuracy on GSM8K from 74.6% to 80.6%, on MATH from 22.5% to 26.5%, and on AGIEval-Math from 23.5% to 27.9%.

Results show that DVO outperforms other offline preference optimization algorithms across multiple benchmarks under the same number of training steps. For example, a three rounds of DVO training improves Llama3-8B-Instruct's accuracy on GSM8K from 74.6% to 80.6%, on MATH from 22.5% to 26.5%, and on AGIEval-Math from 23.5% to 27.9%.
